subject: Important Update: Changes to our Customer Support Hours
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you that starting next week, our customer support hours will be changing. Our new hours will be Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We believe this adjustment will allow us to better serve you and provide timely assistance. Thank you for your understanding and continued support. Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.
